Host jumpbox
    HostName 10.10.0.1
    User alice
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa
    Port 22

Host dbserver db
    HostName 10.10.1.20
    User root
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/root_key
    Port 2222

Host bastion-*
    HostName bastion.example.com
    User ops
    ProxyJump jumpbox

Host 10.10.2.*
    User deploy
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/deploy_key

Host *
    ServerAliveInterval 60
    StrictHostKeyChecking ask
